versions.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-ai-doctor.
- Provides standardized diagnostic and troubleshooting workflow for OpenClaw AI agents.
- Covers common issues such as startup errors, deadlocks, tool/plugin failures, memory overflows, and session problems.
- Includes step-by-step intake, system check, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up process.
- Lists detailed command-line instructions for addressing identified issues.
- Service tiers and contact information included for further support.
